name: AgentMotif
author: AgentMotif
description: Built by AgentMotif for SDK 4.0: material, nature, cosmic, field, type and media looks on a shared physically based lens stack, plus a Lens effect, a Tunnel transition and a reel sequence.

styles.name: Silk Aurora
styles.blurb: Warped drapes shaded as real silk, foil or velvet, with thin-film sheen and pulsing aurora veins.

flow.label: Flow cycles / loop
flow.hint: Integer, so the loop closes exactly.

drift.label: Drift
drift.hint: How far the warp travels each loop.

mat.label: Material
mat.hint: Changes the BRDF: satin, anodised foil or velvet sheen.

stretch.label: Drape stretch
stretch.hint: Anisotropy: long drapes vs. crumpled cloth.

veins.label: Aurora veins
veins.hint: Emissive iso-lines that pulse along the folds.

exposure.label: Exposure
exposure.hint: Scene exposure in stops, before tone mapping.

tonemap.label: Tone map
tonemap.hint: AgX rolls highlights off without hue skew; Neutral keeps brand colours.

threshold.label: Bloom threshold
threshold.hint: HDR level where glow starts (soft knee).

halation.label: Halation
halation.hint: Film emulsion: highlights bleed warm red.

ca.label: Chromatic aberration
ca.hint: 7-tap spectral lateral CA toward the frame edges.

styles.name: Liquid Chrome
styles.blurb: Raymarched liquid-metal metaballs lit by a procedural photo studio, with mirror floor and anodised film.

blend.label: Merge
blend.hint: Smooth-union radius: how gooey the merge is.

spin.label: Studio turns / loop
spin.hint: Rotates the lights so reflections sweep across the surface.

steps.label: Quality (steps)
steps.hint: Raymarch steps. Lower for live performance.

styles.name: Painterly
styles.blurb: Turns any photo or clip into living gouache: Kuwahara patches, structure-aligned strokes, paper tooth, boil.

inputs.label: Source
inputs.hint: Photo or clip to paint. Without one, a landscape plays.

harmony.label: Palette harmony
harmony.hint: Pulls hues toward the palette; 0 keeps the photo's colour.

boil.label: Boil
boil.hint: Hand-made jitter on twos, like painted animation.

styles.name: Liquid Glass
styles.blurb: Merging glass lozenges that refract your media with spectral dispersion, bevel highlights and frost.

inputs.label: Source
inputs.hint: Photo or clip to paint. Without one, a landscape plays.

backdrop.label: Backdrop
backdrop.hint: Used when no media is attached.

merge.label: Merge
merge.hint: Pieces fuse like liquid when they meet.

frost.label: Frost
frost.hint: Disc blur through the glass (32 taps × 7 wavelengths: costly).

styles.name: Light Tunnel
styles.blurb: Shatters any image into converging speed streaks around a vanishing point, with rushing light and zoom blur.

inputs.label: Source
inputs.hint: Photo or clip to stretch. Without one, a trail scene plays.

radius.label: Stretch radius
radius.hint: Inside stays sharp; beyond, the image smears into streaks.

squash.label: Streak length
squash.hint: 0 = infinite streaks; higher keeps some of the outer image.

breathe.label: Breathe
breathe.hint: The stretch front travels in and out once per loop.

styles.name: Astral Fold
styles.blurb: The Astral method as a named renderer: cosine coordinate folds, a glow step field and additive light, or a stable volume.

renderer.label: Renderer
renderer.hint: Glow is the original look; Volume keeps exposure stable across Quality.

amp.label: Fold amplitude
amp.hint: a: how far each cosine layer pushes the coordinates.

effects.name: AgentMotif Lens
effects.blurb: Two-level bloom, halation, spectral CA, vignette and 24 fps film grain for any layer or the finished frame.

transitions.name: Tunnel Cut
transitions.blurb: The outgoing shot shatters into speed streaks, the cut lands at full stretch, the new shot settles out.

exporters.blurb: 16:9 1080p WebM, two loops, for a page background.
